Workflow.Name: DealOS | Review decisions
Workflow.Description: Review task Approved or Rejected (via the Approvals flow or directly in the admin app) → apply it: publish listing, send the approved request to the party, set trust tier, clear screening, issue contract, instruct a fund release (gc_InstructRelease), plan a shipment.
